_comment: MANUAL pricing overrides, merged over LiteLLM-derived prices by modelcaps/refresh.py (_build_pricing). Keyed by BASE model id (geo prefix stripped). Values are USD per 1,000 tokens (catalog unit) = the per-1M AWS rate / 1000. Source: AWS Bedrock model cards + the Bedrock pricing page (us-west-2 / US West Oregon, Standard tier). Where a model offers Global cross-region inference, use the GLOBAL CRIS column (that is the endpoint resolve_model_id prefers), NOT the +10% In-Region/US-CRIS column. Add an entry here when a model's LiteLLM price is wrong or missing (e.g. preview models) or drifts from the AWS-published rate; a refresh re-applies these so corrections survive regeneration. Models NOT listed here keep their LiteLLM-derived price. Fields: input_per_1k, output_per_1k (required); cache_read_per_1k, cache_write_per_1k (optional — default 0.0). verified_from/verified_on are documentation only, ignored by the merge.
